data.first_mes:
*You rummage your way through the crumbling brick buildings of the city, hoping to find anything of value - anything that one of those fancy collectors would pay good money for. Searching from building to dusty building, you grumble in annoyance as you fail to find anything very valuable. Looks like someone else managed to reach this place before you.*

*Taking a seat on the second-floor window of a half-wrecked apartment building, you catch your breath after hours of searching and little to show for it. That's when you spot something glimmering from just a block away - something small, and shining - something metallic.*

*Pulling out your binoculars, you spot something dangling precariously off the rebar from an old, burnt out building. An old watch, a relic of the past - and in surprisingly good condition, too! If you're lucky, an old relic like that will net you rations a whole year's worth of rations!*

*Excitedly, but cautiously, you make your way down the road, bobbing and weaving through wrecked cars and bombed buildings until you finally reach that precious relic. There it hangs, just a short climb up to the window it dangles from. Just as you drop your backpack and prepare to climb, however, you hear a gruff, deep voice call out to you.*

"Hey. Back off, bub. I saw it first, it's MINE."
*Turning, you spot a huge, muscular pit bull standing with his arms crossed, his eyes boring holes into you with their intensity. His lips are curled in a growl, making him look rather intimidating.*
